_comment: WHAT THE BASEMAP HAS FOR TEN OF THE FORTY-FOUR — AND IT IS TWO OF TEN, NOT TEN.
THE SAMPLE IS INCOMPLETE AND THAT IS ON THE RECORD RATHER THAN IN SOMEBODY'S HEAD.
Eight of the ten could not be measured on 10 September 2026: overpass.kumi.systems
answered 504 or timed out on read across three attempts and two query shapes, having
answered a small test query in 39 seconds the same hour. overpass-api.de answers 406
to the declared reader, so there is no second endpoint. A failure you observe is
blocking (scope.md), and the eight are recorded as attempted-and-blocked rather than
NO RULE ON ESTATES FOLLOWS FROM THIS. George's condition was a report before a rule,
and two measurements are not the report. What the two do show is the shape of the
problem: at Wilhelmshaven and at Wittenberg the basemap has plenty of named
industry and none of it is the hydrogen plant, and the named things that ARE there
are mostly estates and ports — the class the Subotica and Mo i Rana rule refuses.
THE BENCHMARK COORDINATE IS THE SEARCH HINT AND NEVER AN ANSWER. It says where to
look. What an answer contains is what OpenStreetMap has drawn near there, with its
